components.provenance: Read-only observer over the convergence-owned Living bounded survey. It reflects bounded progress and availability without owning search state, invoking searchWorlds or enterKey, exposing canonical keys, enumerating the universe, or creating a second discovery UI.

Non-owning Living accessibility augmentation. Unknown stage remains unknown; the canonical viewport label and aria-pressed state are preserved. Reversible aria-current is added only when no other owner already supplies that attribute and yields permanently if another owner changes it. Keyboard-shortcut metadata uses only unambiguous tokens. Skip routing, focus continuity, transition announcements, bounded survey UI and context docking remain convergence-owned Living capabilities rather than duplicated lane UI.

Lane-owned styling is restricted to the optional systemic-audio controls and status: compact 44/48px targets, focus-visible, forced-colors and reduced-motion handling. It does not style or create duplicate Living skip, context, survey, focus or announcement surfaces.
